def check_constraints():
    from z3 import (Int, Bool, Solver, Function, IntSort, Or, Not, And, sat)

    # Base script variables
    cms = Int('cms')

    # Variables from constraint set 2
    operation = Int('operation')
    SMIME_SIGNERS = Int('SMIME_SIGNERS')
    SMIME_SIGN = Int('SMIME_SIGN')
    SMIME_SIGN_RECEIPT = Int('SMIME_SIGN_RECEIPT')
    SMIME_ENCRYPT = Int('SMIME_ENCRYPT')
    SMIME_IP = Int('SMIME_IP')
    CMS_STREAM = Int('CMS_STREAM')

    digestbin = Int('digestbin')
    digestlen = Int('digestlen')
    flags = Int('flags')

    sksigners = Int('sksigners')
    i = Int('i')
    rr = Int('rr')
    si = Int('si')
    kparam = Int('kparam')
    key_first = Int('key_first')
    key = Int('key')
    signer = Int('signer')
    rr_to = Int('rr_to')
    rr_allorfirst = Int('rr_allorfirst')
    rr_from = Int('rr_from')

    srcms = Int('srcms')
    sis = Int('sis')

    in_ = Int('in_')
    pwri_pass = Int('pwri_pass')
    pwri_tmp = Int('pwri_tmp')
    secret_key = Int('secret_key')
    secret_keylen = Int('secret_keylen')
    secret_keyid = Int('secret_keyid')
    secret_keyidlen = Int('secret_keyidlen')
    encerts = Int('encerts')
    ri = Int('ri')
    wrap_cipher = Int('wrap_cipher')
    wctx = Int('wctx')
    res = Int('res')
    pctx = Int('pctx')
    cert = Int('cert')

    # Uninterpreted functions
    CMS_final_digest = Function('CMS_final_digest', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    CMS_add1_ReceiptRequest = Function('CMS_add1_ReceiptRequest', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    cms_set_pkey_param = Function('cms_set_pkey_param', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    make_receipt_request = Function('make_receipt_request', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    CMS_final = Function('CMS_final', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    CMS_add0_recipient_password = Function('CMS_add0_recipient_password', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    CMS_add0_recipient_key = Function('CMS_add0_recipient_key', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    sk_X509_num = Function('sk_X509_num', IntSort(), IntSort())
    CMS_RecipientInfo_type = Function('CMS_RecipientInfo_type', IntSort(), IntSort())
    EVP_EncryptInit_ex = Function('EVP_EncryptInit_ex', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    sk_X509_push = Function('sk_X509_push', IntSort(), IntSort(), IntSort())
    sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num = Function('sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num', IntSort(), IntSort())

    s = Solver()

    # Base constraint
    s.add(cms == 0)

    # Constraint 1
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(operation == SMIME_SIGN, digestbin != 0, (flags & CMS_STREAM) == 0)),
        CMS_final_digest(cms, digestbin, digestlen, 0, flags) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 2
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        Not(And(rr != 0, CMS_add1_ReceiptRequest(si, rr) == 0))
    ))

    # Constraint 3
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        Not(kparam != 0),
        cms_set_pkey_param(pctx, kparam) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 4
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        si != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 5
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        Not(And(kparam == key_first, kparam != 0)),
        kparam == 0,
        kparam != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 6
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        key != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 7
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_OPENSSL_STRING_num(sksigners))),
        signer != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 8
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        operation != SMIME_SIGN,
        Not(rr_to != 0),
        make_receipt_request(rr_to, rr_allorfirst, rr_from) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 9
    s.add(Or(
        (operation & SMIME_SIGNERS) == 0,
        operation != SMIME_SIGN,
        cms != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 10
    s.add(Or(operation != SMIME_SIGN_RECEIPT, srcms != 0))

    # Constraint 11
    s.add(Or(operation != SMIME_SIGN_RECEIPT, sis != 0))

    # Constraint 12
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        (flags & CMS_STREAM) != 0,
        CMS_final(cms, in_, 0, flags) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 13
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(pwri_pass != 0),
        CMS_add0_recipient_password(cms, -1, 0, 0, pwri_tmp, -1, 0) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 14
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(pwri_pass != 0),
        pwri_tmp != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 15
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(secret_key != 0),
        CMS_add0_recipient_key(cms, 0, secret_key, secret_keylen, secret_keyid, secret_keyidlen, 0, 0, 0) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 16
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_X509_num(encerts))),
        Not(And(CMS_RecipientInfo_type(ri) == 0, wrap_cipher != 0)),
        EVP_EncryptInit_ex(wctx, wrap_cipher, 0, 0, 0) == 1
    ))

    # Constraint 17
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_X509_num(encerts))),
        Not(And(res <= 0, res != -2))
    ))

    # Constraint 18
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_X509_num(encerts))),
        Not(kparam != 0),
        cms_set_pkey_param(pctx, kparam) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 19
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_X509_num(encerts))),
        ri != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 20
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        Not(And(i >= 0, i < sk_X509_num(encerts))),
        Not(And(kparam == key_first, kparam != 0)),
        kparam == 0,
        kparam != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 21
    s.add(Or(operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT, cms != 0))

    # Constraint 22
    s.add(Or((operation & SMIME_IP) == 0, cms != 0))

    # Constraint 23
    s.add(Or(
        operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT,
        sk_X509_push(encerts, cert) != 0
    ))

    # Constraint 24
    s.add(Or(operation != SMIME_ENCRYPT, cert != 0))

    return s.check() == sat
